title: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 charact
question: Identify the first 10 words, sorted alphabetically, that are 4 to 5 characters long, start with 'r', and have at least one anagram of the same length, considering case-sensitive letters. Provide the count of such anagrams for each word.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT words,
         (SELECT group_concat(c, '') FROM (
            SELECT substr(words, pos, 1) AS c
            FROM (SELECT 1 AS pos UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) p
            WHERE pos <= length(words)
            ORDER BY c
         )) AS key
  FROM word_list
  WHERE length(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT key, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM base
  GROUP BY key
)
SELECT b.words,
       (c.total - 1) AS anagram_count
FROM base b
JOIN cnt c ON b.key = c.key
WHERE substr(b.words, 1, 1) = 'r'
  AND c.total > 1
ORDER BY b.words
LIMIT 10

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT words,
         (SELECT group_concat(substr(words, pos, 1), '') FROM (SELECT 1 AS pos UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5) WHERE pos <= length(words) ORDER BY random()) AS sig
  FROM word_list
  WHERE length(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND words LIKE 'r%'
)
SELECT b.words, COUNT(*) AS anagram_count
FROM base b
JOIN base a ON a.sig = b.sig AND a.words <> b.words
GROUP BY b.words
ORDER BY b.words
LIMIT 10
